wbgt_propagation.method: thermofeel 2.3.0 calculate_wbgt_liljegren (wind_scaling='liljegren'); radiation (GHI, fdir=direct/GHI) and surface pressure from the same model for both runs; SSRD converted to instantaneous with the backward->instant factor, cos(zenith) instantaneous at t (pvlib SPA). 'obsmet' = METAR T, Td (->RH via Magnus 17.625/243.04) and 10 m wind.
